title: Universal derived counit transport after ordinary coefficient identification
statement: Let R0,B0,R,B be commutative rings in a common universe, with algebra structures R0→B0 and R→B. Choose derived categories of R0,B0 in morphism universe w and of R,B in possibly distinct universe w′ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let L0:D(R0)→D(B0) and L:D(R)→D(B) have universal left-derived counits for ordinary scalar extension [def-weil-module-base-change]. Let eR:R0≃R and eB:B0≃B be compatible ring equivalences. Fix i. Write V for termwise restriction along eR, U for restriction along eB, T0,T for ordinary termwise scalar extension, and P0,P for localization followed by L0,L and degree-i homology. Define c0,c on each complex by applying homology to its counit and composing with the derived and homotopy homology factorization isomorphisms. Given a natural isomorphism t:V⋙T0≅T⋙U_complex whose degree-j component sends b⊗x to eB(b)⊗x for every complex, there is a natural isomorphism d:V⋙P0≅P⋙U satisfying d_K followed by U(c_K) = c0_(VK) followed by H^i(t_K) and the exact-restriction homology isomorphism. There are no extra algebra-action or model-cohomology objects in this statement.

proof.text: Apply the raw derived counit transport to obtain E, its complex-localization factorization q, the natural isomorphism a, and its derived-category counit equation.

Apply the proved exact-restriction homology factorization theorem to E and q to obtain z with its factorization equation. Define d by whiskering a with H₀ and composing with z whiskered by the derived scalar-extension functor on complexes.

Use naturality of z at ε_K, the factorization equation for z at T(K), H₀ applied to the raw counit equation, and naturality of the composite derived/homotopy homology factorization at t_K. Associativity gives exactly the original displayed square.

theorem exists_derivedExtension_ringEquiv_counit
    {R₀ B₀ R B : Type u}
    [CommRing R₀] [CommRing B₀] [CommRing R] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R₀ B₀] [Algebra R B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R₀)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} B₀)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (L₀ : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R₀) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B₀))
    (L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B))
    (ε₀ : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L₀ ⟶
      (extendScalars (algebraMap R₀ B₀)).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
      (extendScalars (algebraMap R B)).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (h₀ : L₀.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε₀ (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)))
    (h : L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)))
    (eR : R₀ ≃+* R) (eB : B₀ ≃+* B)
    (hRB : eB.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap R₀ B₀) =
      (algebraMap R B).comp eR.toRingHom) (i : ℤ) :
    let π₀ := HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R₀) (.up ℤ)
    let π := HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)
    let H₀ := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B₀) i
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i
    let P₀ := π₀ ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L₀ ⋙ H₀
    let P := π ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⋙ H
    let V := (restrictScalars.{u} eR.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let U := restrictScalars.{u} eB.toRingHom
    let T₀ := (extendScalars (algebraMap R₀ B₀)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let T := (extendScalars (algebraMap R B)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let c₀ := fun K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R₀) ℤ ↦
      H₀.map (ε₀.app (π₀.obj K)) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactorsh (ModuleCat.{u} B₀) i).hom.app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj (T₀.obj K)) ≫
        (HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctorFactors (ModuleCat.{u} B₀) (.up ℤ) i).hom.app
          (T₀.obj K)
    let c := fun K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ ↦
      H.map (ε.app (π.obj K)) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactorsh (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).hom.app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj (T.obj K)) ≫
        (HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctorFactors (ModuleCat.{u} B) (.up ℤ) i).hom.app
          (T.obj K)
    ∀ (t : V ⋙ T₀ ≅ T ⋙ U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
      (_ht : ∀ (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (j : ℤ) (b : B₀) (x : K.X j),
        (t.hom.app K).f j (b ⊗ₜ[R₀,algebraMap R₀ B₀] x) =
          eB b ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R B] x),
      ∃ d : V ⋙ P₀ ≅ P ⋙ U,
        ∀ K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ,
          d.hom.app K ≫ U.map (c K) =
            c₀ (V.obj K) ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (t.hom.app K) i ≫
              ((T.obj K).sc i |>.mapHomologyIso U).hom
